title: News from JMonkeyEngine - 14 April 2021
content:
Thank you for your contribution(s)!

A "stable" version of the v3.3 SDK was released on 5 April: https://github.com/jMonkeyEngine/sdk/releases/tag/v3.3.0-stable-sdk1

Version 3.4 of the Engine reached its "feature freeze" milestone and entered its beta-test phase on 13 April: https://github.com/jMonkeyEngine/jmonkeyengine/releases/tag/v3.4.0-beta1

The project has not paid any expenses since November.
